SUPERSESSION.why: Off-geometry throughout. Every arm ran at n_generated=400; the committed sweep kernel froze n=120 (scripts/kaggle/glm_paired_sweep_kernel.py:45). The all-coupled arm is documented in this file as reproducing the status quo and was never reconciled against it: at n=400 it reports `both` sd 0.0140, while the committed grid's own ten nulls have sd 0.0410. Because the comparison BETWEEN arms was the entire finding, no number here describes the committed geometry.
SUPERSESSION.what_is_WITHDRAWN: All of it: every arm sd, the decomposition, both verdicts, the 7.18x additivity ratio and the anchor sweep. The anchor sweep in particular must not be cited as a surviving control, because it ran at the same wrong geometry as the arm it was validating.
SUPERSESSION.the_mechanism_that_was_withdrawn: This file attributes a coupled variance below the sum of the decoupled ones to the Markov null being fitted on the fit half of the very corpus draw it is scored against. That is true of the runner -- and it is equally true in EVERY arm here, because each arm took fit and eval from one corpus call. A property held constant across all arms cannot explain a difference between them, so this file could not have measured its own stated mechanism. The arm that does test it directly (F_fit_decoupled in v2) returns an sd ratio of 1.129 with a bootstrap interval of [0.891, 1.445], which contains 1.

question: Of the across-seed spread in generator distinguishability, how much is nuisance (corpus draw + discriminator split) that a seed-role split would remove, and how much is the candidate's own sampling?
probe_candidate: MarkovGenerator(order=3) -- chosen because it is free to replicate; NOT the HF generator

arms.A_all_coupled: one seed drives corpus shuffle, generation RNG and discriminator split
arms.B_generation_only: corpus and split pinned at seed 7; generation RNG varies
arms.C_corpus_only: generation RNG pinned at seed 7; corpus and split vary

kmer.reading: independent contributors would make the coupled variance roughly the SUM; a ratio well above 1 means the roles are NEGATIVELY correlated and cancel inside a seed

both.reading: independent contributors would make the coupled variance roughly the SUM; a ratio well above 1 means the roles are NEGATIVELY correlated and cancel inside a seed

mechanism_anchor_sensitivity.rival_status: REFUTED: the generation-only spread exceeds the all-coupled spread at EVERY anchor tested (sd 0.022-0.0288 vs coupled 0.014), so it is not a property of one anchor corpus.

honest_limits: Measured on the MARKOV candidate. It bounds the INSTRUMENT nuisance variance and says nothing about the HF generator own sampling variance, which may be larger or smaller.
Arm C varies corpus AND split together, so it does not separate those two roles from each other; it bounds their combined contribution.
10 replicates per arm, so each SD is itself imprecise -- a ratio of two SDs at n=10 is a coarse reading, not a tight estimate.
The verdict thresholds (0.5, 0.8) are STATED, not derived. The raw ratios are reported so a reader is not limited to the band.

The cancellation MECHANISM (the null is fit on the same corpus draw it is scored against) is supported by the additivity ratio and by the anchor sweep, but it is not isolated by an experiment that removes the fit-set matching directly.
The anchor sweep varies WHICH corpus is pinned; it does not test a non-Markov candidate, so the cancellation is established for this null and not for generators in general.
